propositions: An optional isolated adapter must mine local Claude Code session transcripts to reconstruct environment/integration diagnosis history without being imported by core metrics command.

Error signatures (ModuleNotFoundError, ConnectionError, timed out, HTTP 429, command not found, etc.) are extracted via grep from transcript JSONL and deterministically classified into enums without LLM calls.
Every emitted classified record carries source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified labels to explicitly mark low-confidence backfilled data.
Unit tests assert the adapter module defines the classification enum (env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, none) and validates fixture transcripts are extracted and routed correctly.
Core metrics modules (registry.py, __init__.py) must not import the adapter to enforce portability and core command isolation.
The backfill script entry point is tested end-to-end over fixture transcript directories and emits properly labeled classified records.
